scope: Read-only C18 original request observation, C03 policy/environment and revised tests. No tests/builds run by reviewer.
findings: Each request constructs a new projectionRequest with original min(start+5s, caller, identity, audit invocation) and monotonic shortening; no shared authority cache.

Initial ResolveProjectionCurrent value is retained only after full construction and planning checks; poll starts with empty owner and completes one fresh CheckProjectionCurrent. Failure is remembered and cannot trigger a later refresh in the same owner.

Current checks preserve exact query scope, installation, identity-policy revision, original authority and dependency bounds. They recheck owned/caller cancellation and clock after blocking mutex/port operations.

C03 retains initial/final ordinary ReadApproved evaluation and exact protected catalog/retention/environment comparisons; placement selection shares protected configuration only, never DownloadAuthority or download entitlement. Policy keeps raw original five-second dates; no 60-second download lease relabeling.

PermitQuery/PermitReadBatch still enter real current SQL guards, lock current recovery/permission/backing/query state, compare permission epoch/sequence/digest, retention and processing before/after effects and retain original deadlines.

Replacement assertions intentionally separate unchanged in-request observation from fresh next-poll reconstruction, source-slice ownership, original cancellation/expiry and immediate SQL refusal. Revised presentation tests use original short authority before the call and SQL retention refusal; they preserve blocked-write cancellation/join and unknown cleanup accounting.
limitations: Source review only; individual synthetic fence tests do not establish real SQL or installed qualification.
This review does not claim a measured availability improvement or a mandatory five-second revocation delay; current SQL/transport checks can deny earlier.
